args.script: (() => { const txt = document.body.innerText; const idxs = []; const re = /\$\s?[0-9][0-9,]*(?:\.\d{2})?|starting at|Starting At|price|5090/gi; let m; let out=[]; while((m=re.exec(txt)) && out.length<80){ out.push({match:m[0], pos:m.index, context:txt.slice(Math.max(0,m.index-120), m.index+160)});} return JSON.stringify(out, null, 2); })()

args.script: (() => { const html = document.documentElement.innerHTML; const patterns = ['Starting at','starting at','$','1,999','1999','price','msrp']; const results = {}; for (const p of patterns) { const idxs=[]; let i=-1; const needle=p.toLowerCase(); const hay=html.toLowerCase(); while((i=hay.indexOf(needle, i+1))!==-1 && idxs.length<20){ idxs.push({pos:i, context:html.slice(Math.max(0,i-250), i+350)}); } results[p]=idxs; } return JSON.stringify(results, null, 2).slice(0,20000); })()
